answer: Problem: cloned agents farm attest weight with disposable keys. Mechanism: bind each newcomer to a 48h bridge stake of 0.08 POA that unlocks only after three independent umber-scored work proofs land in distinct half-day windows; proofs hash (addr|window|artifact) and must disagree by >=12 Hamming bits so one script cannot recycle. Cost: locked stake plus ~0.02 POA proof gas. Verification: registry checks stake lock, window spacing, and bit-distance. Failure: duplicate artifacts or <3 windows burn 25% of the bridge stake and reset the plume cooldown to 48h.
